KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable pathfinding
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Constrain token dragging on gridless scenes with wall-aware paths, squeezing, and hostile-token collision.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.SqueezeFactor.Name: Squeeze footprint factor
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.SqueezeFactor.Hint: Squeeze radius as a fraction of the normal footprint radius. 0.5 matches the D&D 5e one-size-smaller squeezing rule.
Movement cost multiplier applied only to path segments that require squeezing. D&D 5e uses 2.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.MarkerDiameter.Hin: Diameter of the circular interaction marker shown at squeeze-only passages, measured in scene units.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.MarkerPadding.Name: Squeeze marker activation padding (feet)
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.MarkerPadding.Hint: Extra activation area around the squeeze marker, in scene units.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnemyPolicy.Name: Enemy collision
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnemyPolicy.Hint: Which token dispositions block movement. Friendly tokens never block.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.IncludeHidden.Name: Include hidden enemies
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.IncludeHidden.Hint: Whether hidden and secret hostile tokens block movement. Off by default so unseen tokens do not trap players.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnforceBudget.Name: Enforce movement budget
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnforceBudget.Hint: During combat, stop the path at the last affordable point using the active movement type when the system exposes a movement speed. Outside combat, costs are shown but movement is not clamped.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.ShowCostLabel.Name: Show cost label
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.ShowCostLabel.Hint: Draw the physical distance and adjusted movement cost next to the path preview.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log drag decisions and planning diagnostics to the browser console.
KNKR_PATHING.Keybindings.Toggle.Name: Toggle pathfinding
KNKR_PATHING.Keybindings.Toggle.Hint: Temporarily enable or disable Knkr Pathing for this client.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.System: Knkr Pathing is designed for the D&D 5e system. Wall and enemy collision still work, but movement budgets are unavailable.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.GriddedScene: Knkr Pathing only operates in gridless scenes.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.MultiToken: Knkr Pathing constrains one token at a time; this multi-token drag was left to Foundry.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.PlanningFaile: Knkr Pathing could not calculate a path for this drag. Foundry's normal placement was used.
